_doc: Move specific appearances off a shared same-name record onto their own person, BEFORE apply_merges. Run by split_appearances.py right after split_swilliams. Each rule: from (canonical_name + source), the appearances whose context starts with context_prefix, and the new person's canonical_name.

rules.context_prefix: Reform lectures of John Allen in Pittsburgh
rules.note: North Star, Feb. 18, 1848: a Massachusetts land reformer lecturing in Pittsburgh. Not the John Allen who was secretary of the 1827 Protecting Society; split off 2026-11-01 so that record could merge into Winch's Allen, John (Michiko's ruling).
